annotations.title: Estimate the monthly Simples Nacional DAS, bracket and effective rate

description: Computes the monthly DAS of a Brazilian Simples Nacional company from its revenue of the last 12 months (RBT12) and the month's revenue: it picks the bracket of the chosen anexo, applies the fixed deduction to get the effective rate, and, when you send the 12-month payroll, applies the 28% Fator R rule that moves service companies between Anexo III and Anexo V. It also flags the BRL 3.6 million sublimit and the BRL 4.8 million ceiling. Use it for monthly tax provisioning, pricing a service, or deciding whether raising pro-labore to reach Fator R pays off. Do not use it for Lucro Presumido or Lucro Real companies, for an MEI, whose DAS is a fixed monthly amount, or to file or pay the DAS, which happens on PGDAS-D. Read 'simplesNacional'. Costs 0.008 USDC per call, paid with x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453) or with a B2B X-API-Key; an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header instead of an exception, and every failure is a JSON body with 'error', so an agent loop never breaks on a thrown error. Deterministic arithmetic at the edge: nothing is stored or filed, no government system is contacted, and the same input always gives the same numbers. Results are estimates for planning and reconciliation, not a substitute for an accountant's sign-off.

aiSummary.description: When true (the default) the response carries 'aiExecutiveBrief', one Portuguese sentence of at most 35 words with the key amounts, written by an edge model with a deterministic fallback. Set false to skip it when you only need the numbers.

anexo.description: Anexo of the activity: I commerce, II industry, III and V services, IV construction, cleaning and security. 'auto' (default) chooses between III and V by Fator R, falling back to V without payroll12m.

monthlyRevenue.description: Revenue of the month being assessed, in BRL. The DAS is this amount times the effective rate.

payroll12m.description: Total payroll of the last 12 months, in BRL, including pro-labore and INSS employer charges. Needed for the Fator R; when given it decides between III and V even if anexo says otherwise.

rbt12.description: Gross revenue of the 12 months before the assessed month, in BRL, for example 720000. Selects the bracket; above 4800000 the company is outside the Simples and 'alert' says so.

name: calculate_simples_nacional_das

outputSchema.description: Single JSON document. All three tools of this server share one paid call and return the same envelope; each fills the block named in its description.

aiExecutiveBrief.description: One Portuguese sentence with the key amounts, present unless aiSummary is false.

error.description: Portuguese failure reason, present only on a rejected call, such as an invalid JSON body (HTTP 400).

processingTimeMs.description: Edge processing time in milliseconds, also in the X-Processing-Time-Ms header.

simplesNacional.description: Simples Nacional DAS estimate. All amounts in BRL as plain numbers, rounded to cents.

alert.description: Portuguese warning when a limit is exceeded, otherwise null.

appliedAnexo.description: Anexo actually used. Between III and V the Fator R decides whenever payroll12m is given, overriding the request.

deductionBRL.description: Fixed deduction of the bracket, in BRL.

effectiveRatePct.description: Effective rate ((rbt12 x nominal - deduction) / rbt12), in percent with three decimals.

estimatedDasBRL.description: Estimated DAS for the month: monthlyRevenue x effective rate.

exceedsSimplesLimit.description: rbt12 above BRL 4.8 million, the Simples Nacional ceiling.

exceedsSublimit3600k.description: rbt12 above BRL 3.6 million, where ICMS and ISS leave the DAS.

faixa.description: Revenue bracket 1 to 6 of the applied anexo.

fatorR.description: payroll12m divided by rbt12 to four decimals, null when payroll12m was not sent.

fatorRQualified.description: True when Fator R is at least 0.28, which moves services from Anexo V to Anexo III.

nominalRatePct.description: Nominal rate of the bracket, in percent.

rbt12.description: Gross revenue of the last 12 months used for the bracket.

suggestedNextSteps.description: Chaining hints for autonomous agents: sibling paid APIs commonly called next, such as a CNPJ check of the Simples Nacional status. Purely advisory.

endpoint.description: Absolute HTTPS endpoint of the follow-up API.

priceUsdc.description: Price of the follow-up call in USDC.

tool.description: Tool name of the suggested follow-up API.

when.description: Condition under which the follow-up is worth making.
